actions.label: Call to Distant Guardians
actions.resolution: Armed silhouettes gather beneath the immense horse.
actions.template: Take any number of {predicate} cards from 4 random choices
actions.effect_text: Take any number of Warrior cards from 4 random choices

events.ranking_rationale: The imposing encounter supports a specific guide reward and a warrior choice that both reinforce the source strategy.

events.prose: You peer between two travelers as an enormous mounted figure dissolves into starlight.

actions.label: Touch the Drifting Specks
actions.resolution: Each bright mote settles into a different form.
actions.template: Transfigure all cards in your deck
actions.effect_text: Transfigure all cards in your deck

actions.label: Reach Through the Silhouette
actions.resolution: A living figure emerges from the thinning outline.
actions.template: Change $DECK_CARD to become a {card_type}
actions.predicate_exception_rationale: The source can materialize ≤2● cost characters from the void, and 94 canonical ≤2● cost Events are eligible for conversion.
actions.effect_text: Change a ≤2● cost Event card in your deck to become a Character

events.ranking_rationale: Visible dissolution makes both alterations direct, while converting a cheap Event creates a new target for the source ability.

events.prose: Before you, two small travelers stand beneath a horse whose shadow fills the sky.

actions.label: Invite Another Traveler
actions.resolution: A newcomer steps onto the broad trunk.
actions.template: Gain $OFFERED_CARD
actions.effect_text: Gain the offered card

actions.label: Address the Colossal Figure
actions.resolution: The mounted figure descends beside the travelers.
actions.template: Gain a random legendary card.
actions.effect_text: Gain a random legendary card.

events.ranking_rationale: The extreme scale is immediately clear and supports two arrivals, while the rewards advance the deck less specifically.

events.prose: A vast horse looms above you and two travelers balanced on a mossy fallen trunk.

actions.label: Make Room on the Limb
actions.resolution: A second companion climbs into the cleared space.
actions.template: Gain {count} copies of $DECK_CARD
actions.effect_text: Gain 1 copy of a chosen ≤2● cost Character card from your deck

actions.label: Signal the Distant Silhouette
actions.resolution: Armed strangers descend through the glittering air.
actions.template: Gain {count} random {predicate} cards
actions.effect_text: Gain 2 random Warrior cards

events.ranking_rationale: Both rewards strongly serve cheap-character and warrior play, but the duplicate's arrival is less visually specific.

events.prose: You look past two travelers toward a mounted giant breaking into scattered light.

actions.label: Call for an Escort
actions.resolution: A disciplined company assembles along the broad limb.
actions.template: Choose one of 2 packs of {predicate} cards to add to your deck
actions.effect_text: Choose one of 2 packs of Warrior cards to add to your deck

actions.label: Touch the Falling Light
actions.resolution: The scattered points trade places throughout the sky.
actions.template: Replace all of your dreamsigns with random dreamsigns
actions.effect_text: Replace all of your dreamsigns with random dreamsigns

events.ranking_rationale: The dissolving silhouette supports both responses, though the random dreamsign exchange is only flexible rather than archetype-specific.
